name: io.github.honzsik/idoklad-mcp
title: iDoklad
description: Unofficial iDoklad invoicing: read and create invoices, proformas, credit notes and contacts.

environmentVariables.name: IDOKLAD_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID from iDoklad → Settings → API

environmentVariables.name: IDOKLAD_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client Secret from iDoklad → Settings → API

environmentVariables.name: IDOKLAD_APPLICATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client Id of a ClientCredentials app on developer.idoklad.cz

environmentVariables.name: IDOKLAD_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to enable tools that create or change data (default true)
